name: Chase Hooper
summary: An American lightweight grappler (17-6, age 27). He was knocked out in R1 twice in a row (Alexander Hernandez, Lance Gibson Jr.) before submitting Mitch Ramirez (R1) in July.

how_they_fight.Grappling: Excellent: nine submissions, six of them in R1 (Leavitt, Guida, Ramirez).
how_they_fight.Defense: Three R1 knockout losses (Garcia, Hernandez, Gibson).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fine over three rounds (decision wins over Fiore and Miller).

patterns: Knocked out early by powerful strikers
keys_to_beat: Keep it standing and hit him early
